item.title: GovBrief Today #553
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled weeks ago that Donald Trump cannot erase birthright citizenship with an executive order. Today he tried again. He signed two new orders restricting who is born a citizen, called the 6 to 3 ruling from his own conservative majority "very unfortunate," and told reporters "we're making adjustments." The Constitution says every baby born in America is a citizen. He is making adjustments everywhere the answer is no. His FCC just voted to erase a broadcast ownership cap Congress wrote into law, a power Senate Commerce Chairman Ted Cruz doubts it has. And the union of career IRS auditors joined a suit to block the audit shield his administration built around his family's taxes. The objections come from his own side now and have changed nothing. I've emailed 8,551 stories over 553 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. item.description: "You don’t even realize how much either your mom or your dad... helps hold that pressure back." A stark, honest breakdown of the reality of falling into homelessness. When the basic systems fail—staying clean, staying fed, staying in good spirits—the tumble begins. Without a home to recuperate in, the cycle quickly spirals out of control.
